nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What has recent research indicated about the relationship between DEET and health issues?
nodes.answer: Recent research has indicated a significant correlation between DEET and increased levels of serum uric acid, as well as the occurrence of chronic ailments such as gout, diabetes, hypertension, and chronic renal illnesses.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What climatic condition is predicted to make cold-adapted high-altitude populations of L. tityrus more sensitive to host plant fertilization?
nodes.answer: It is predicted that higher ambient temperatures will make cold-adapted high-altitude populations of L. tityrus more sensitive to host plant fertilization.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: By how much could the average temperatures in Eritrea increase by 2080 according to the studies referenced?
nodes.answer: The average temperatures in Eritrea could increase by up to 3.39°C by 2080.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Why are low-income countries in the tropics more vulnerable to emerging diseases?
nodes.answer: Low-income countries in the tropics are more vulnerable to emerging diseases due to compounding risk factors.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How is climate change expected to impact bat distribution?
nodes.answer: The study of future climate change impacts to the distribution of bats is critically important for both human and animal health.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What species is the focus of the study regarding climate change and disease emergence risks?
nodes.answer: The focus of the study is the common vampire bat, Desmodus rotundus.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_006
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What factors were analyzed to assess the impact of climate change on the distribution of the vampire bat?
nodes.answer: The analysis included comparisons of different climate change periods, carbon emission scenarios, and global circulation models (GCMs).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_007
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are some expected consequences of D. rotundus expanding into new areas?
nodes.answer: The expansion of D. rotundus may impact new mammalian species and livestock with unexpected consequences.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_008
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Why might some areas in the Americas need to assess their preparedness regarding D. rotundus?
nodes.answer: They may need to prepare for the expected range expansion of D. rotundus and its potential impacts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_009
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How does climate change influence disease emergence according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Climate change may increase distributional shifts that facilitate the transmission of pathogens to novel hosts, acting as a potential driver of disease emergence.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_010
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What geographical disparities exist in the impacts of climate change on health regarding emerging infectious diseases?
nodes.answer: The impacts of climate change on health are not evenly distributed, with some tropical areas being more affected due to ecosystem degradation and climate change.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_011
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What phenomenon was documented in Peru regarding D. rotundus and VB-RABV?
nodes.answer: An expansion of the geographic distribution of VB-RABV outbreaks in livestock and a shift of D. rotundus populations into higher elevations was documented in Peru.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Infectious diseases prevention and control|Climate change and infectious diseases_qna_012
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How can future climate change impact D. rotundus distribution?
nodes.answer: Future climate change may continue to shift the distribution of D. rotundus and potentially lead to further VB-RABV spillover.
